metadata.title: Lens space surgeries on knots of small genus
metadata.abstract: We prove that the $(-2,3,7)$ pretzel knot is the only hyperbolic knot of genus at most $5$ with a lens space surgery. Our key technical result asserts that if a genus-$g$ hyperbolic knot $K$ has an elliptic surgery of slope greater than $4g-3$, then the invariant foliations of its monodromy have an orientation that is reversed by the monodromy, and so the opposite of the dilatation must be a root of the Alexander polynomial of $K$. Combined with prior work of Moser, Wu, Bleiler--Litherland, Baker, and Greene, this verifies the Berge conjecture for knots of genus at most $5$.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 小亏格结的 lens space 手术分类
analysis.workSummary: 证明亏格至多五、容许 lens space 手术的双曲结只有 (-2,3,7) pretzel 结；以大斜率椭圆手术对 monodromy 叶状结构及 Alexander 多项式的约束，结合既有工作验证此亏格范围的 Berge 猜想。
analysis.breakthrough: 完成亏格≤5 范围的 Berge 猜想验证。
analysis.limitations: 唯一性针对双曲结；整体 Berge 结论结合了其他类型结的既有分类。
analysis.priorityReason: 完成亏格≤5 范围的 Berge 猜想验证。
